title: MCP protocol implemented by hand rather than via the official mcp SDK
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/server.py:225 handle_message dispatches initialize/ping/tools/list/tools/call as raw JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio; no mcp SDK import. Protocol version 2024-11-05 advertised at server.py:20.
suggestion: Acceptable — the protocol is correctly implemented with zero dependencies. Noted only because most implementations use the mcp SDK; the hand-rolled server is not spec-tested against a real MCP client.

title: Unknown competition filter silently returns zero results instead of signalling
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/names.py:113 resolve_competition returns query.strip() (not None) when no alias matches; find_matches then compares match.competition != comp (queries.py:178) and filters out every match, yielding an empty answer for a typo'd competition.
suggestion: Consider surfacing an 'unknown competition' hint, or listing known competitions, so a mistyped filter is distinguishable from a genuinely empty result.
